positioning: CHAMPION V2 / ALL-IN PREGAME TOTALS (Leon, 2026-07-07): the board's pick product is the CHAMPION V2 stream — the champion's own live totals engine (pick source, unchanged) + V4 serving discipline (the +EV/vig gate at the REAL latest per-side price, champion-edge star tiers capped at 4, nightly grading). See the `champion_v2` block. The v4 model grid below is TOTALS-ONLY (spread/ML cells removed from the pick product; their record survives under record.legacy_all_markets). The +EV/vig gate is unchanged and hard (-EV never emits). This feed still does NOT touch the champion's pregame_picks serving path; the champion engine continues to run untouched — V2 only READS its stores. champion_v2.what: CHAMPION V2 — the board's pick product: the champion's own live totals engine (unchanged) + V4 serving discipline (+EV/vig gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers by the champion's own edge size, nightly grading). PREGAME TOTALS ONLY.
champion_v2.star_basis: STAR SYSTEM v3 (Leon, 2026-07-07): RATE EVERY GAME — every row carries 1-5 stars, an always-populated lean={side,line}, a continuous 0-5 score, and playable=(stars>=2). 1 star = WE WOULD PASS (the lean is still stated, clearly labeled Pass): rows that fail the +EV gate at the real latest per-side price, and the toxic tail |edge| >= 0.065 — measured ANTI-signal on the champion's own graded 2022-2026 history (33-43, hit 43.4%, ROI -17.1%; 947 graded picks, 892 decided, day-clustered 95% bootstrap CIs — v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md). Playable tiers are the MEASURED divergence bands: 4 stars = Tier A 0.04 <= |edge| < 0.065, the sweet spot (248-153, hit 61.8% [57.1-66.5], ROI +17.6% [+8.6..+26.5], ROI-positive every season 2022-2026); 3 stars = 0.03-0.04 (234-177, hit 56.9% [52.4-61.6], ROI +8.7% [-0.0..+17.8]); 2 stars = the smallest playable edges, |edge| < 0.03 past the +EV gate (Tier B lives here — only 4 graded decided picks ever, thin history, lowest playable conviction). The +EV gate is the PLAYABLE boundary: a -EV row can NEVER be 2 stars or better. CEILING 4 stars — the champion is NOT BH-certified on the v4 sealed walk (dev-null on re-derivation), so 5 stars stays reserved for BH-certified cells. score = stars + a within-band blend of edge size and EV (score = stars + 0.99*(0.5*pos_edge + 0.5*pos_ev); pos_edge = |edge| position inside the star's measured band (tail inverted — deeper anti-signal scores lower); pos_ev = EV position (playable: EV_MIN..0.10 -> 0..1; passes: -0.10..EV_MIN -> 0..1, no price -> 0). Monotone blend; score never crosses a star boundary.). CONVICTION FLOOR (Leon, 2026-07-08: stop pure price-chasing flip-flops): PLAYABLE additionally requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE — |our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01. A row that clears +EV purely on plus-money juice while the model essentially agrees with the fair number is a 1-star 'price-only edge — no model conviction' lean, never playable. PLAYABLE = +EV at the real per-side price AND model divergence >= 0.01. STAR v3.1 (Leon, 2026-07-07, same day: 'normalize all picks — I want to make sure we get some 4s'): the DISPLAYED playable stars (2-4) are now NORMALIZED PERCENTILE BANDS of that unchanged continuous score among playable rows season-wide — 4 stars = top ~10% of playable scores, 3 stars = next ~25%, 2 stars = the rest — with the two cutoff score values FROZEN from the season replay distribution (payload `star_cutoffs`; v4/models/output/star_cutoffs_v31.json), recomputed only on the nightly replay regen, never per-day. The measured absolute-edge-band records quoted above are the SCORE's basis, not the star bands' — under v3.1 the tiers are relative conviction and the by_star_tier records in the record block are the live measurement of what each band earns. The 1-star PASS set, the +EV playable boundary, the 4-star ceiling and featured (= highest score) are all unchanged; a non-playable row is never promoted.
model_notes: HARD LOCK + CONVICTION FLOOR (Leon, 2026-07-08): (1) picks HARD-LOCK at first pitch — once a game starts, its board rows are IMMUTABLE (the judged Vegas line/side/price/stars freeze at the last pre-start state; grading uses exactly that locked state; `locked_at` carries the freeze wall + timestamp). Each WALL row is also first-write-wins: once written it is never overwritten by a later cycle. (2) playable now requires REAL MODEL DIVERGENCE (|our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01) on top of +EV — micro-edges that only exist because of plus-money juice are 1-star 'price-only' leans. Both fixes answer the observed all-unders -> all-overs board flip between cycles: unstable price-driven micro-edges are no longer playable, and nothing re-writes after the freeze.

DEV-NULL (2026-07-07, v4/models/UNIFIED_TOTALS.md): the champion's edge does NOT reproduce when re-derived on the Odds-API 5-DP odds table — the champion-style path graded flat (+0.1% on 283 dev picks, 2022-25) and the V4 GBM residual path was actively anti-signal at high divergence (-16.6%). CHAMPION V2 therefore uses the champion's OWN pipeline (its snapshot stack + frozen model + frozen policy) as the pick source; V4 adds serving-time discipline (+EV gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers, nightly grading) — it does NOT re-derive the signal.

HABITAT EROSION WARNING: the champion's trigger habitat — cross-book totals dispersion — is structurally shrinking: T-3h line_std 0.126 (2023) -> 0.096 (2024) -> 0.083 (2025) -> 0.076 (2026); share of slates with >=2 distinct lines 67% -> 48% -> 43% -> 39%; books quoted 16.7 -> 11.7 -> 10.9 -> 11.0. Expect fewer qualifying picks over time. The record display is the ongoing proof either way — no edge is presumed.

STAR RECALIBRATION (2026-07-07, v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md): star tiers were re-fit to the champion's own measured 2022-2026 bucket win-rates (day-clustered CIs). The edge-ROI gradient is NOT monotone — it is an inverted U: 0.03-0.04 hit 56.9% ROI +8.7%; 0.04-0.065 hit 61.8% ROI +17.6%; >= 0.065 hit 43.4% ROI -17.1% (extreme divergence is where the champion is most WRONG, not most right; sweet-spot-vs-tail ROI gap +34.8pp, 95% CI +11.4..+58.1). Stars therefore peak at 0.04-0.065 and the >= 0.065 tail is demoted out of the playable tiers.

STAR SYSTEM v3.1 (2026-07-07, Leon: 'normalize all picks — I want to make sure we get some 4s'): playable stars re-tiered from absolute edge bands to NORMALIZED PERCENTILE BANDS of the unchanged continuous score (4* = top ~10% of playable scores season-wide, 3* = next ~25%, 2* = rest; cutoffs frozen from the season replay distribution, refreshed only on the nightly regen). Honest consequence: a star tier is now a RELATIVE conviction band, not a measured edge bucket — read the by_star_tier records for what each band actually earns. The -EV floor is hard (normalization never promotes a non-playable row); 1* passes, the toxic-tail demotion, the 4* ceiling and featured are unchanged.

STAR SYSTEM v3 (2026-07-07, same day, Leon): rate EVERY game — no empty cells. 1 star now MEANS 'we would pass' (the lean side+line is still shown); the toxic >= 0.065 tail is a 1-star PASS, no longer a bet, so the headline record is over the PLAYABLE (2-4 star) set. Tier B moved from a 1-star lean to 2 stars: it clears the +EV gate below 0.03 divergence — playable at the lowest conviction, on thin history (4 graded decided picks ever), not on proven skill. Every row carries a continuous 0-5 `score` (stars + within-band edge/EV blend) and the payloads expose per-day featured_game_id = the highest score of the day (playable first; all-pass days feature the best lean, flagged).

gated_out.note: rows rated 1-star PASS under star v3 (fail the +EV gate at the real per-side price, sit below the 0.01 model-divergence conviction floor, or sit in the measured >=0.065 anti-signal tail). Shown on the board with their lean, never bet; their would-have record is informational only. would_have_record covers ONLY the n_graded rows with a win/loss/push result; n_pending_or_no_result rows are counted here explicitly and excluded from the counterfactual record — never silently dropped.

star_spec.version: v3.1 (Leon, 2026-07-07: normalized percentile star bands — score unchanged)
star_spec.5: RESERVED — BH-certified cell (none yet); never remapped by normalization
star_spec.4: playable, score >= star_cutoffs.cutoff_4 — the top ~10% of playable scores season-wide (v3.1 normalized band)
star_spec.3: playable, star_cutoffs.cutoff_3 <= score < cutoff_4 — the next ~25% of playable scores
star_spec.2: playable, score < star_cutoffs.cutoff_3 — the remaining playable rows (lowest playable conviction)
star_spec.1: WE WOULD PASS — every 1* row still states its lean (side+line), clearly labeled Pass. Holds: -EV / no-real-price rows, price-only edges (|our_prob − market_devig_prob| < 0.01 — +EV from juice-shopping, no model conviction), the toxic >=0.065 tail (measured anti-signal: hit 43.4%, ROI -17.1%), and junk (degenerately one-sided) cells
star_spec.playable_boundary: PLAYABLE (2*+) = +EV at the real per-side price AND model divergence |our_prob − market_devig_prob| >= 0.01 (the conviction floor, Leon 2026-07-08). A -EV row or a price-only micro-edge can NEVER be 2*+; playable == (stars >= 2)
star_spec.no_zero_star: every row is rated 1-5; there is no 0* / empty cell
star_spec.score: score = stars + 0.99*(0.5*pos_edge + 0.5*pos_ev); pos_edge = |edge| position inside the star's measured band (tail inverted — deeper anti-signal scores lower); pos_ev = EV position (playable: EV_MIN..0.10 -> 0..1; passes: -0.10..EV_MIN -> 0..1, no price -> 0). Monotone blend; score never crosses a star boundary.
star_spec.lean_field: every row carries lean={side,line} — populated on passes too
star_spec.featured: featured_by_date[date].featured_game_id = the highest score of the day among playable rows (champion_v2 + v4 grid); if nothing is playable, the highest-score 1* lean with an explicit all_pass note
star_spec.evidence_field: every row carries evidence={cell_cleared_baselines, bh_significant, cell_n, one_sided} so the UI can show why a demotion applies
star_spec.normalization_note: v3.1 (Leon, 2026-07-07): playable stars are PERCENTILE BANDS of the continuous score among playable rows, NOT absolute edge bands. The score is unchanged (absolute, model-driven — the ranking truth). Cutoffs are frozen season-wide from the replay distribution (see `star_cutoffs`), recomputed only when this payload regenerates (nightly), never per-day — a dead slate cannot fake a 4*. The -EV floor is HARD: normalization never promotes a non-playable row. Tiers are therefore relative conviction — the by_star_tier records are what each band actually measured.

star_cutoffs.version: v3.1 (Leon, 2026-07-07: normalized percentile star bands — score unchanged)
star_cutoffs.basis: v3.1 percentile bands of the (unchanged) continuous score over ALL playable rows of the season replay (v4 totals grid + champion_v2 2026 backfill). Frozen ABSOLUTE score thresholds for live serving — recomputed only when the replay payload regenerates (nightly), never per-day, so a dead slate cannot fake a 4*. The -EV floor is hard: non-playable rows stay 1* regardless of score.

star_census.honest_note: STAR SYSTEM v3.1 over the latest walk: every row is rated 1-5 (no empty cells; 1* = rated PASS with the lean still stated — -EV / no-price / price-only micro-edges below the 0.01 divergence floor / toxic >=0.065 tail / junk one-sided cells). Playable stars (2-4*) are now NORMALIZED PERCENTILE BANDS of the continuous score among playable rows season-wide (4* = top ~10%, 3* = next ~25%, 2* = the rest; frozen cutoffs in `star_cutoffs`), NOT absolute edge bands — so a tier is a RELATIVE conviction band and its ROI below is the honest measurement of that band, nothing more. The score itself is unchanged (absolute, model-driven) and the +EV gate is unchanged and hard: normalization can never promote a non-playable row. On THIS walk 0/15 cells cleared the anti-trivial baselines and 0 are BH-significant — so 5* is empty. Read the by_star_tier ROI before trusting any tier.
